mission.title: Strong authentication and privileged access — KRL-ADM
mission.system_criticality: Supporte des fonctions critiques ou importantes (DORA)
scope_in: Paramètres d'authentification et de session de la console KRL-ADM
Comptes disposant d'un accès à la console
scope_out: Efficacité intrinsèque des facteurs MFA (robustesse des moyens d'authentification)

control.title: Mandatory MFA for privileged accounts
control.objective: MFA is enforced for all privileged admin accounts on KRL-ADM
control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that mfa_admin is true
control.risk: Without MFA for admins, stolen credentials allow full takeover of critical functions with no second barrier
control.recommendation: Enable mandatory MFA for all privileged accounts by setting mfa_admin to true

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows admin MFA as Désactivée, matching the automated test failure.

control.title: Mandatory MFA for users of critical system
control.objective: MFA is enforced for standard users because KRL-ADM supports critical or important functions
control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that mfa_users is true
control.risk: Without MFA for all users, compromised user credentials allow unauthorized access to critical functions
control.recommendation: Enable mandatory MFA for standard users by setting mfa_users to true

test.code:
import requests
import json
import os
import sys
import re

try:
    base = os.environ["LAB_URL"]
    token = os.environ["LAB_TOKEN"]
except KeyError as e:
    print(f"missing environment variable: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

url = re.sub(r"/+$", "", base) + "/api/security"
headers = {"Authorization": "Bearer " + token}

try:
    r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
except Exception as e:
    print(f"request failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

if r.status_code != 200:
    print(f"unexpected status {r.status_code} for GET /api/security", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

try:
    data = r.json()
except Exception as e:
    print(f"invalid json: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

if not isinstance(data, dict) or "mfa_users" not in data or not isinstance(data["mfa_users"], bool):
    print("missing or invalid mfa_users field", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)

observed = data["mfa_users"]
status = "pass" if observed is True else "fail"
print(json.dumps({"status": status, "observed": observed, "expected": True, "detail": f"mfa_users is {observed}."}))

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows user MFA as Désactivée, confirming mfa_users is false.

control.title: Strong password policy
control.objective: Passwords require a minimum length of 12 characters with complexity requirements enabled
control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify password_min_length and password_require_complexity
control.risk: Weak or short passwords can be guessed or brute-forced, enabling unauthorized access to the system
control.recommendation: Enforce a minimum password length of 12 characters with complexity by correcting the password settings

before.detail: password_min_length is 6 and password_require_complexity is False.

inspection.field_text:
Longueur minimale du mot de passe 6
Complexité du mot de passe exigée Désactivée
inspection.comment: The screenshot shows minimum password length 6 and complexity disabled, matching the automated test failure.

control.title: Account lockout after failed logins
control.objective: Accounts lock after at most 5 failed login attempts and lockout is never disabled
control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that lockout_threshold is between 1 and 5 inclusive
control.risk: Without lockout, attackers can perform unlimited password-guessing attacks against accounts
control.recommendation: Configure account lockout to 5 attempts at most by setting lockout_threshold between 1 and 5

before.detail: lockout_threshold is 0, which is outside the required range 1 to 5 inclusive.

inspection.field_text: Verrouillage après N échecs de connexion Aucun
inspection.comment: The screenshot shows account lockout set to Aucun, confirming the disabled lockout reported as 0.

control.title: Inactive session timeout
control.objective: Inactive sessions expire after at most 15 minutes and expiration is never disabled
control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that session_timeout_minutes is between 1 and 15 inclusive
control.risk: Unlimited inactive sessions allow session hijacking and unauthorized use of unattended workstations
control.recommendation: Enforce inactive session expiration at 15 minutes at most by setting session_timeout_minutes between 1 and 15

before.detail: Observed session_timeout_minutes is 0, outside the required 1 to 15 inclusive.

inspection.comment: The security policy table shows inactive session expiration set to Never.

control.title: Logging of administration actions
control.test_procedure: Retrieve the security configuration via GET /api/security and verify that admin_audit_log is true
control.risk: Without admin audit logging, privileged actions cannot be traced, preventing detection and investigation of abuse
control.recommendation: Enable logging of all administration actions by setting admin_audit_log to true

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows Journalisation des actions d'administration as Activée, matching the automated pass result.

control.title: No generic or shared admin accounts
control.objective: No account with role admin is generic or shared and every admin has a nominative login of the form initiale.nom with a personal email
control.test_procedure: Retrieve all accounts via GET /api/users and verify that every user with role admin has a nominative login and a personal email without function identifier or shared mailbox
control.expected: for all users where role == admin: login matches initiale.nom pattern and email is personal, with no function login and no shared mailbox
control.risk: Generic or shared admin accounts destroy individual accountability and prevent attribution of privileged actions
control.recommendation: Remove or disable generic and shared admin accounts and replace them with dedicated nominative accounts

before.expected: for all users where role == admin: login matches initiale.nom pattern and email is personal, with no function login and no shared mailbox
before.detail: 1 of 2 admin account(s) violate nominative login or personal email requirements.

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows admin account ops with generic login and shared mailbox ops-partage@kerlann-banque.example, confirming the automated failure.
